negative_findings.description: A direct fetch of the RBI investor reports hub (https://www.rbinternational.com/en/investors/reports.html) returned report categories (semi-annual, annual, quarterly, regulatory disclosures) and headline metrics, but no mention of Ukraine on the landing page itself — only repeated 'excl. Russia' framing.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ukraine-specific figures are not exposed on the IR landing page; they live inside the report PDFs and the XLSM results file, so the landing page alone is not a usable extraction target.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must go one level deeper (into the PDF/XLSM artefacts) rather than scraping the IR index; a shallow crawler would wrongly conclude RBI does not report Ukraine.

negative_findings.description: No named 'Ukraine segment' was found in Crédit Agricole S.A. group-level reporting; searches surfaced only the Ukrainian subsidiary's own site as the source of Ukraine P&L and ratios.
negative_findings.result_summary: Crédit Agricole's Ukraine disclosure is subsidiary-published (credit-agricole.ua press centre + documents page), not parent-segment-published.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's premise (Ukraine data hiding inside Vienna/Budapest/Paris group reports) holds strongly for RBI, OTP and ProCredit but only weakly for Paris; collection design must differ per parent.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief names a 'Pyrkal/Bank Pivdenny-type minority' foreign-stake tier. Searching in Ukrainian for Bank Pivdenny management reports and foreign shareholders did not return a foreign parent group publishing a Ukraine segment or country annex.
negative_findings.result_summary: No foreign-parent IR channel identified for Bank Pivdenny; only local/media profiles were found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For minority-foreign-stake banks the group-disclosure channel appears absent, so this tier must be covered by local statutory disclosure (NBU, SMIDA, bank site) instead — a different collection design.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian-language equivalent of parent-group 'segment reporting' vocabulary was found in use on parent IR sites; Ukrainian search terms only reach subsidiary-level documents (річний звіт, фінансова звітність, звіт про управління).
negative_findings.result_summary: Parent-group Ukraine annexes exist only in EN (and HU/DE for OTP/RBI/ProCredit domestic filings); uk-language search cannot reach them.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A uk-only crawl systematically misses the group channel, and an en-only crawl misses the local statutory channel — both language passes are structurally required for this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Hungarian- and German-language filings of the parent groups (OTP's BSE/Hungarian filings, RBI's German-language Geschäftsbericht, ProCredit's German annual financial statements) were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a hu/de search leg using terms such as 'ukrajnai leánybank', 'szegmens', 'Segmentberichterstattung Ukraine', and check the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE/BÉT) and German Bundesanzeiger filing channels.

coverage_gaps.description: Other foreign-parent banks in Ukraine were not enumerated systematically (e.g. Citibank Ukraine, ING Ukraine, Deutsche Bank representative presence, Sense Bank post-nationalisation history, TAScombank-type mixed ownership).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use the NBU institutions register plus its foreign-capital classification to build the full parent-group watchlist, then check each parent's IR site for a Ukraine country annex.

coverage_gaps.description: Regulated-filing venues for the parents (Vienna Stock Exchange / OeKB ad-hoc disclosure, Budapest Stock Exchange filings, EU ESAP/OAM national storage mechanisms) were not scouted; only issuer-hosted IR pages were.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the official appointed mechanisms (OeKB Emittenten, BSE bet.hu company filings, Bundesanzeiger) as machine-readable, timestamped alternatives to issuer PDFs.

coverage_gaps.description: Structured data artefacts (RBI XLSM results file, OTP iXBRL annual report packs, ESEF/iXBRL filings) were identified only by reference, not located at a stable URL.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and pin the direct XLSM/iXBRL download URLs per issuer; these give clean per-country time series and remove PDF-parsing risk.

coverage_gaps.description: All URLs recorded here come from search results or a single fetch; liveness, paywalling and robots/ToS posture were not verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass; treat any 403/timeout (notably investing.com, cbonds, quartr) as bot-defended rather than dead.

brief: Ukraine-specific bank earnings in this cell flow through two structurally different channels that must both be collected. The group channel — RBI (Vienna), OTP (Budapest) and ProCredit Holding (Frankfurt) — carries Ukraine as a named country segment or subsidiary chapter inside English-language annual/quarterly reports, results files and earnings calls; OTP's quarterly 'Summary of results' PDF series is the single most granular and most automatable artefact found. The local channel — Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine, OTP Bank Ukraine, Credit Agricole Bank Ukraine and KredoBank — publishes Ukrainian-language IFRS statements, management reports and (for Crédit Agricole) a disciplined quarterly bilingual results press release, with SMIDA and the NBU registers acting as pointers/actor maps. Crédit Agricole is the exception to the cell's premise: Paris does not break Ukraine out as a segment, so its Ukraine data is subsidiary-published. Minority-foreign-stake banks such as Bank Pivdenny showed no foreign-parent IR channel at all and must be covered via local statutory disclosure.
